outgoing.name: Aluminium
outgoing.excerpt: Technologically ground-breaking at the time, this statue was the first in the world to be cast in aluminium.

outgoing.name: Bob Marley
outgoing.excerpt: Bob Marley makes mention of Piccadilly Circus in his song "Kinky Reggae" off of the album Catch A Fire.

outgoing.name: London Underground
outgoing.excerpt: Directly underneath the plaza is the London Underground station Piccadilly Circus.

outgoing.name: Sweden
outgoing.excerpt: Piccadilly Circus is the name of Swedish singer Pernilla Wahlgren's hit song from 1985.

outgoing.name: United States
outgoing.excerpt: In the United States, this would be the equivalent to "it's like Grand Central Station."
